senses.definition: Relating to particular persons or things, each to each; particular; own.
examples: They returned to their respective places of abode.

quotes.text: Adam and Novikovas swapped long-range efforts, neither of which troubled the respective keepers.

senses.definition: (obsolete) Looking toward; having reference to; relative, not absolute.
